description.value: The Co-op Masset Food Store is part of the locally-owned Haida Gwaii Co-op, a community co-operative serving residents and visitors on the remote Haida Gwaii archipelago. As one of the primary grocery options in Masset, it functions as an essential resupply point for touring cyclists on this isolated island chain. Non-members are welcome to shop alongside co-op members.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Haida Gwaii Co-op is a locally-owned co-operative serving Masset (among other communities), consistent with the OSM record 'Co-op Masset Food Store' tagged as shop=supermarket. The website content is heavily template-laden CMS output with no location-specific amenity details, so most amenity fields default to null. Basic groceries is confirmed true by the OSM supermarket tag and the website's explicit mention of 'Food Stores' as a Co-op store type; no other cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water, fuel, etc.) are evidenced in either source.
concerns: Website content is heavily populated with CMS template placeholders, yielding very little specific amenity or contact information for this location.
OSM name is 'Co-op Masset Food Store' while website branding is 'Haida Gwaii Co-op' — minor discrepancy, clearly the same organization.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operational supermarket in Masset and a critical resupply stop for any cyclist touring Haida Gwaii's remote communities.

wow_evidence: locally-owned co-operative serving residents and visitors on the remote Haida Gwaii archipelago
